responsibility: Defines GCC’s global compiler context singleton and the basic lifetime management for process-wide compiler state. It constructs and destroys the top-level gcc::context object, owns the pass manager and dump manager pointers associated with that context, tracks the offloading-presence flag, and performs shutdown cleanup such as releasing MPFR caches to avoid leaked global numeric state.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line definition of the global gcc::context singleton state, including construction/destruction of the global object and cleanup such as MPFR cache release; unlike gcc/context.h, which only declares the context class layout and accessor methods.
